<h2>Trekker Joe’s Affiliate Program</h2>


<h3>About Our Brand and Products</h3>

<p>Trekker Joe’s creates small-batch, eco-conscious hiking gear for those who find freedom on the trail and purpose in simplicity. From our <strong>Ultragrid Water Bottle Sleeves</strong> that balance hydration weight, to our <strong>Ultralight Wallets, Roll-Top Sacks, Zip Pouches, and Fanny Packs</strong> — every product is handmade in Texas with care, precision, and respect for the outdoors.</p>

<p>Our gear is built for hikers who believe that functionality and sustainability belong side by side.</p>


<h3>What Makes Us Different</h3>

<p>We’re not a mass-produced outdoor brand. We’re makers who hike, sew, and test our own gear. Each piece is crafted in small batches using eco-friendly materials and practical design principles born from the trail. We also give back — 1% of all revenue supports the <strong>Great Springs Project</strong>, building connected trails between Austin and San Antonio, Texas.</p>


<h3>How Affiliates Can Earn</h3>

<p>As a Trekker Joe’s Affiliate, you’ll earn a <strong>6% commission</strong> on every sale made through your referral link. The more you connect with outdoor enthusiasts who value quality gear and small business ethics, the more you earn. There is no earnings cap</p>


<h3>How to Promote Us</h3>

<p>Share what you love most about the outdoors — and how our gear fits into that story. Whether through <strong>Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or blogs</strong>, your voice helps others discover gear that aligns with their values. Highlight our craftsmanship, sustainability, and handmade detail. Use your personal adventures and real experiences to tell that story authentically.</p>


<h3>Other Information</h3>

<p>We welcome creators, hikers, backpackers, photographers, and advocates for sustainable outdoor living. You’ll gain access to early product releases, media assets, and features through our partner network. Together, we can inspire more people to explore responsibly — and make every step count.</p>


<p><strong>Join Trekker Joe’s Affiliate Program</strong> today and help us share a different kind of trail story — one built on authenticity, sustainability, and the love of the outdoors.</p>
